1. Restriction to Jammu & Kashmir Only. Participation in this bid shall be strictly restricted to sellers/firms having theirr egistered o ffice or authorized operational presence within the Union Territory of Jammu & K ashmir. The bidder shall upload valid documentary proof establishing its business presence in Jam mu & Kashmir, such as: GST Registration Certificate; Udyam Registration Certificate; Trade/Business Licence; Shop & Establishment Registration Certificate; or Any other valid Government-issued registration document establishing the business l ocation in Jammu & Kashmir. Bids submitted by firms having no registered office or authorized operational presen ce within the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir shall be treated as non-responsi ve and liable for rejection. 2. Analytical Report / Quality Control Report Mandatory with S upply. The supplier shall mandatorily submit the Analytical Report / Quality Control Report al ong with the supplied items. The Analytical/Quality Control Report shall: Be issued by the manufacturer's Quality Control Laboratory or a NABL-accredited/G overnment-approved laboratory, wherever applicable; Correspond to the batch number of the supplied items; Clearly mention the Batch No., Manufacturing Date, Expiry Date and relevant test results/compliance; and Establish conformity of the supplied item with the prescribed quality standards/specifi cations. Supply without the required Analytical/Quality Control Report shall be treated asi ncomple te and liable for rejection, and payment shall not be processed until the required docum ents are furnished and the supply is accepted. 3. Price Inclusive of All Taxes and Charges. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties and incidental cha rges, including but not limited to: GST; Transportation/Freight; Loading and unloading charges; Packing and forwarding charges; Insurance; and Any other incidental expenses. No additional charges over and above the accepted/quoted price shall be payable by the B uyer.

The quoted rates shall remain firm during the entire contract period, subject to applica ble Government/GeM provisions. 4. Product Quality and Shelf Life. All items supplied shall strictly conform to the specifications, standards and requirem ents prescribed in the bid. Items supplied shall be new, unused and of standard quality. Medicines/drugs supplied shall have a minimum 75% remaining shelf life or 18 m onths validity, whichever is higher, at the time of delivery, wherever applicable. Expired, damaged, substandard, short-dated or otherwise non-conforming items shall be liable for rejection. The supplier shall bear all costs associated with the replacement of rejected items. 5. Delivery Period and Location. The supplier shall complete the supply within 07 to 15 days from the date of issue of the GeM Contract/Purchase Order, as specified in the contract/order. Delivery Location: Government Children Hospital, Bemina, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir. The supplier shall ensure proper packing, transportation and safe delivery of the items at the designated location. 6. Inspection and Acceptance. The supplied items shall be subject to inspection and verification by theC onsignee and/o r Technical Evaluation Committee/authorized inspection team. Inspection may include verification of: Quality; Technical specifications; Quantity; Batch number; Manufacturing and expiry dates; Shelf life; Analytical/Quality Control Report; and Any other relevant requirement specified in the bid. The Buyer reserves the right to reject any item that does not conform to the prescrib ed specifications, quality standards, quantity, documentation or other terms and conditions of the bid. 7. Replacement of Rejected/Defective Items. Any item found to be defective, damaged, substandard, short-dated or not conform ing to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the supplier within0 7 days o f receipt of intimation from the Buyer, at no additional cost to the Buyer. The replacement items shall comply with all prescribed quality and shelf-life requirements. 8. Liquidated Damages (LD). In the event of failure by the supplier to deliver the items within the stipulated delivery peri

od, Liquidated Damages may be imposed at the rate of 0.5% per week of the dela yed supply, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total order value, in accordance with applicable GeM/Government provisions. 9. Payment Terms. Payment shall be made only after: Successful delivery of the ordered items; Inspection and acceptance by the authorized committee/consignee; Submission and verification of the required Analytical/Quality Control Report and othe r prescribed documents; and Submission of the duly prepared bill/invoice in triplicate, wherever required. Payment shall be processed as per applicable GeM rules and Government financial p rocedures, subject to satisfactory acceptance of the supplies. 10. Buyer's Right to Reject/Cancel. The Buyer reserves the right to reject non-responsive bids or non-conforming suppli es and to cancel/terminate the bid/order/contract in accordance with applicable GeM and Government rules, wherever warranted, including in the interest of patient car e, uninterrupted availability of essential items and smooth functioning of the hospital. .
